metadata.source: HUD-USPS ZIP Code Crosswalk (residential-address ratios), combined with the Georgia General Assembly's 2023 Senate, House and Congressional plans and 2020 Census block populations
metadata.kinds: standard = a USPS Georgia delivery ZIP; po-box = PO-box-only, no districts; other = HUD reports residential addresses but the ZIP is not in the USPS Georgia facility list (typically a campus, government or military ZIP); treat like standard.
metadata.meaning: Districts and counties TOUCHING the ZIP, ranked by estimated share of the ZIP's residents, largest first. Every district with any residents is listed. A ZIP is not a district: only a street address identifies the districts a voter lives in. PO-box ZIPs carry no districts.
